people.name: Osho
people.bio: One of the most prolific and radical spiritual teachers of the 20th century. Created hundreds of meditation techniques — including Dynamic Meditation — designed specifically for the modern mind. His 600+ books distil everything from Zen and Tantra to Taoism and Sufism into a single voice of absolute freedom.

people.name: Rupert Spira
people.bio: One of the clearest contemporary teachers of non-dual awareness — his books, videos, and retreats are exceptional.

people.name: Alan Watts
people.bio: The philosopher who brought Eastern wisdom to the West. Thousands of lectures freely available — start anywhere.

people.name: Emma Grede
people.bio: Co-founder and CEO of Good American, co-founder of SKIMS, founding partner of Savage X Fenty. First Black woman guest Shark on Shark Tank. Her bet: inclusivity — across sizing, race, and access — is a billion-dollar market, not a compromise. Proof that conscious business and category-leading scale aren't opposed.

people.name: Lyn Alden
people.bio: The clearest macro analyst covering Bitcoin as an emerging monetary network. Her long-form research bridges traditional finance and the new monetary paradigm.

people.name: Dr. Joe Dispenza
people.bio: Neuroscientist and meditation teacher whose progressive workshops document measurable physiological and psychological transformation through meditation.

people.name: Sarah (Medical Intuitive)
people.bio: Certified Medical Intuitive and Quantum Healer with over 20 years of practice. Sarah reads the energetic and soul-level patterns underlying physical illness — tracking the unconscious distortions, unresolved trauma, and soul lessons that manifest in the body. Available on YouTube and @medicalintuitive.sarah on Instagram.
people.needs_review: No last name in source data. Kept 'Sarah (Medical Intuitive)' as the display name for now. Revisit when/if a fuller name surfaces.

people.name: Marshall Rosenberg
people.bio: The creator of Nonviolent Communication. His work underpins almost all modern conflict resolution.

people.name: Graham Hancock
people.bio: The author and researcher whose work spans lost civilisations, ancient monuments, consciousness, and the hidden history of humanity.

people.name: Randall Carlson
people.bio: Researcher and geometrician mapping the cosmic catastrophes that shaped human history — Hancock's key collaborator.

people.name: Bob Lazar
people.bio: The man who brought Area 51 and element 115 (moscovium) to public consciousness decades before its scientific confirmation. Official site.

people.name: Barbara Marciniak
people.bio: Barbara Marciniak has channeled a collective of multidimensional beings from the Pleiades star system since 1988. Her book Bringers of the Dawn is one of the most widely read channeled texts ever published — a dense, demanding transmission on DNA activation, timelines, and the game being played on Earth.

channels.name: The Pleiadians
channels.description: A collective of multidimensional beings from the Pleiades star system. Their transmissions through Barbara Marciniak since 1988 cover DNA activation, timelines, planetary awakening, and the deeper game being played on Earth — demanding, dense, and among the most widely read channeled material published.

people.name: George Green
people.bio: Former investment banker and USAF veteran who published the Pleiadian-channeled Handbook for the New Paradigm trilogy — available free online and read by millions. His Project Camelot interviews are essential: a man who moved money at the highest levels, who walked away, and who spent his final decades broadcasting what he knew.
people.needs_review: URL points to a specific interview, not a canonical personal site. Consider replacing if one exists.

people.name: Arizona Wilder
people.bio: Former high priestess and MK-Ultra survivor who conducted Illuminati rituals at the highest levels of global power. Her testimony — first recorded with David Icke in Revelations of a Mother Goddess (1999) — covers shapeshifting bloodlines, Satanic ceremony, and the hidden architecture of control. Unfiltered and unflinching.
people.needs_review: URL is her podcast feed, not a personal site. A canonical URL would be better if available.

people.name: Darryl Anka
people.bio: Darryl Anka has channeled Bashar since 1983 — teachings on parallel realities, permission slips, and following your highest excitement.

channels.name: Bashar
channels.description: A multi-dimensional being from a future Earth timeline, channeled by Darryl Anka since 1983. Bashar's teachings center on parallel realities, permission slips, and the practice of following your highest excitement in every moment — one of the most accessible and pragmatic transmissions in contemporary channeling.

people.name: Sai Maa
people.bio: H.H. Sai Maa — spiritual master, humanitarian, and initiator of Shaktipat transmission. Her work bridges Eastern wisdom and Western neuroscience in transformational retreats worldwide.

people.name: Birgit Fischer
people.bio: Austrian medium, healer, and four-time SPIEGEL bestselling author — channels Starseed messages and galactic intelligences. One of the most prominent voices in German-language spiritual media.
people.needs_review: Birgit's source material describes her channels as general ('Starseed messages, galactic intelligences') rather than a single named entity. Left the 'channels' array off for now. If you want to add one or more named channels, I'll add them.

people.name: Dolores Cannon
people.bio: Hypnotherapist, past-life regressionist, and founder of Quantum Healing Hypnosis Technique (QHHT). Across 50 years and tens of thousands of sessions she assembled one of the most coherent bodies of channeled material on Earth — Nostradamus, Jesus, starseeds, the volunteer souls, and the shift into the New Earth. Read her or don't, but you can't study this field without her.

people.name: Joe McMoneagle
people.bio: The most scientifically tested remote viewer in history — over 450 operational intelligence missions for the US government.

people.name: Ra Uru Hu
people.bio: Born Alan Robert Krakower, Ra Uru Hu received the Human Design transmission in 1987 on Ibiza. He spent the rest of his life codifying and teaching the system — the founder and original voice of Human Design.

people.name: Jenna Zoe
people.bio: The most popular contemporary Human Design educator. Her platform makes the system approachable for a modern audience — courses, readings, and a large community. The gateway for most newcomers.

people.name: Karen Curry Parker
people.bio: Reimagined the language of Human Design to be more empowering and less mechanical. Her Quantum Human Design reframes traditional HD language — 'Manifestor' becomes 'Initiator,' etc. Prolific author and teacher.

people.name: Erin Claire Jones
people.bio: Brings Human Design into business, leadership, and teams. Known for making HD practical and applicable to work and relationships. Her newsletter is one of the most-read in the HD space.
